title: Tadd Dameron's band at the Royal Roost
summary: The Royal Roost job let them stay as long as they liked; Fats Navarro, Wardell Gray, Dexter Gordon and Miles Davis passed through, and they recorded Tadd's music.

story.theme_name: Playing with and around Miles Davis
story.community_name: Playing with Miles Davis: joining, sessions and the band

blocks.x: Because Tadd had this job at the Royal Roost.
And like we were there, you know, we could stay there as long as we wanted to.
Oh, we had -- we changed the band quite a bit. We had like Fats Navarro, Wardell Gray, Allen Eager, Dexter Gordon.
Miles Davis. We just about had all the

And -- well, we became the house band. So we began to record quite a bit. Tadd was very popular at that time. And he was writing for Dizzy, you know, things like -- we recorded quite a few of Tadd's things, you know, with Diz's band.
Like, 'Our Delight,' and 'Stay On It,' things like that, you know.
So Tadd was kind of attached to Diz, which we were all attached to Dizzy.
Because Dizzy was the high priest.
